title.zh: Compound DAO used protocol reserves to buy $52 million worth of COMP, and delegates call it a mandate breach
title.en: Compound DAO used protocol reserves to buy $52 million worth of COMP, and delegates call it a mandate breach

current_state.zh: A new on-chain analysis alleges Compound DAO reserves funded a $52M COMP purchase that arrived in a DAO reserve wallet 58 minutes before Proposal 582's voting snapshot, giving supporters a bare delegated-vote majority and prompting delegate claims of a mandate breach.
current_state.en: A new on-chain analysis alleges Compound DAO reserves funded a $52M COMP purchase that arrived in a DAO reserve wallet 58 minutes before Proposal 582's voting snapshot, giving supporters a bare delegated-vote majority and prompting delegate claims of a mandate breach.
